pkgmetadata.longdescription: QSoC is a System on Chip design studio. It reads and writes Verilog and SystemVerilog with the slang front end, describes register maps with SystemRDL, and generates RTL, testbenches and documentation from project descriptions. A command line and TUI front end share a project format with the Qt GUI. An agent runtime and an SMT worker run as helper processes next to the main program.
QSoC 是一个片上系统设计工作台。它使用 slang 前端读写 Verilog 与 SystemVerilog，用 SystemRDL 描述寄存器映射，并根据工程描述生成 RTL、 测试平台与文档。命令行与 TUI 前端和 Qt 图形界面共享同一工程格式。 agent 运行时与 SMT 求解进程作为主程序的辅助进程运行。
